frame: one outdoor scene of low grass on bare earth under plain sky, seen from the front, same viewpoint and size on the page. Only the thing changes: a narrow trodden path running to the horizon with a small figure on it, or a squat toad sitting in the grass.
sentence_nl: Het pad is smal en de pad zit stil.
sentence_en: The path is narrow and the toad sits still.

frame: one small furry animal sitting side-on on a flat grass line under plain sky, whole body, same size and pose on the page, no burrow, no person. Only the animal changes: a round rabbit with short ears and a small tail, or a lean hare with very long ears and long hind legs.
sentence_nl: Het konijn woont in een hok, de haas in het veld.
sentence_en: The rabbit lives in a hutch, the hare in the field.

frame: one large sea animal swimming side-on under a flat wavy water line, whole body, same size and direction on the page, no boat, no person, no other fish. Only the animal changes: a shark with gill slits and a pointed snout, or a dolphin with a short beak and a blowhole.
sentence_nl: De haai heeft kieuwen, maar de dolfijn ademt lucht.
sentence_en: The shark has gills, but the dolphin breathes air.

frame: one winged insect resting on the edge of a plain leaf, seen slightly from the side, whole insect, same size on the page, wings drawn as outlines with simple vein lines and no pattern. Only the insect changes: a butterfly with clubbed antennae and wings folded upright, or a moth with feathery antennae and wings lying flat like a roof.
sentence_nl: De vlinder vliegt overdag, de mot vliegt 's nachts.
sentence_en: The butterfly flies by day, the moth flies at night.

frame: one small four-legged animal standing side-on on a flat grass line beside a low plain fence, whole body, same size on the page, no saddle, no rider. Only the animal changes: a donkey with very long ears and a thin tail with a tuft, or a pony with short ears, a thick mane and a full tail.
sentence_nl: De ezel heeft lange oren en de pony heeft korte oren.
sentence_en: The donkey has long ears and the pony has short ears.

frame: one empty bird home in the middle of the picture, seen side-on, the same size on the page, no bird, no eggs, plain background. Only the home changes: a round nest of woven twigs in the fork of a branch, or a domed cage of thin bars with a small closed door.
sentence_nl: Een wilde vogel woont in het nest, een tamme vogel in de kooi.
sentence_en: A wild bird lives in the nest, a tame bird in the cage.

frame: one bird standing side-on on a flat ground line under plain sky, the same bird in the same size and pose on the page, wings folded; a small ring marks the featured part at normal size, with no enlargement. Only the ringed part changes: the tail, the leg and foot, or the wing.
sentence_nl: De staart is lang, de poot is dun en de vleugel is breed.
sentence_en: The tail is long, the leg is thin and the wing is broad.

frame: one small body of fresh water in a grassy field under plain sky, seen from slightly above, the same field at the same size on the page, no person, no boat. Only the water changes: a narrow stream winding across the field, or a round still pond with reeds at the edge.
sentence_nl: De beek stroomt naar de rivier, de vijver ligt stil.
sentence_en: The stream flows to the river, the pond lies still.

frame: one wide empty landscape seen from the front under plain sky, the same horizon line at the same width on the page, no person, no animal. Only the ground changes: dry rolling sand with ripple lines and one cactus, or wet ground with reeds, tufts of grass and pools of standing water.
sentence_nl: De woestijn is heel droog, maar het moeras is nat.
sentence_en: The desert is very dry, but the marsh is wet.

frame: one small sailing boat lying still on a flat wavy water line, seen side-on, the same boat at the same size on the page, no person, no flag; a small ring marks the featured part at normal size. Only the ringed part changes: the anchor, the sail or the mast.
sentence_nl: Het anker ligt op het dek, het zeil hangt aan de mast.
sentence_en: The anchor lies on the deck, the sail hangs from the mast.

frame: one garden boundary running across the whole picture on a flat grass line, seen from the front, the same height and length on the page, plain sky, no gate, no person. Only the boundary changes: an open fence of thin upright bars you can see through, or a closed fence of wooden boards.
sentence_nl: Door het hek zie je de tuin, achter de schutting niet.
sentence_en: Through the railings you see the garden, behind the board fence you do not.

frame: one bed cover spread over a made bed with one plain pillow, seen from the side and a little above, the same bed at the same size on the page, no person, no pattern. Only the cover changes: a thin flat blanket with a stitched border, or a thick puffy duvet with stitched squares.
sentence_nl: De deken is dun, het dekbed is dik en zacht.
sentence_en: The blanket is thin, the duvet is thick and soft.

frame: one house drawn as a cross-section, seen from the front, with a ground line across it, two floors, a pointed roof and a room under the ground, the same house at the same size on the page; a ring marks one space. Only the ringed space changes: the room under the ground or the space under the roof.
sentence_nl: De kelder is onder het huis, de zolder is boven in het huis.
sentence_en: The cellar is under the house, the attic is at the top of the house.

frame: one block of flats seen from the front with a small round table and two chairs outside, plain sky, the same building at the same size on the page, no person. Only where the table stands changes: on a paved floor at ground level, or on a railed ledge sticking out from an upper floor.
sentence_nl: Wij zitten op het terras, de buren zitten op het balkon.
sentence_en: We sit on the terrace, the neighbours sit on the balcony.

frame: one empty container with a carrying handle over the top, standing on a flat floor line against a plain wall, seen side-on, the same height on the page, nothing inside. Only the container changes: a woven basket with a curved handle, or a smooth metal bucket with a thin wire handle.
sentence_nl: De appels gaan in de mand en het water gaat in de emmer.
sentence_en: The apples go in the basket and the water goes in the bucket.

frame: one adult face seen from the front, close up from the nose to the chin, mouth wide open as when saying aah, the same face at the same size on the page; a small ring marks the featured part at normal size. Only the ringed part changes: the tongue, one tooth or the lower lip.
sentence_nl: De tong proeft, de tand bijt en de lip is zacht.
sentence_en: The tongue tastes, the tooth bites and the lip is soft.

frame: the same adult head as the gezicht set, seen three-quarter from the front in plain cobalt line, whole head, neutral mouth, no hair detail, the same size and position on the page; a small ring marks the featured area at normal size, with no enlargement. Only the ringed area changes: the cheek, the chin or the forehead.
sentence_nl: De kin is onder de mond, de wang naast de neus en het voorhoofd boven de ogen.
sentence_en: The chin is below the mouth, the cheek beside the nose and the forehead above the eyes.

frame: one adult standing whole-figure, front view, plain clothes, arms hanging slightly away from the body, on a flat ground line against a plain wall, the same figure at the same size on the page; a small ring marks one joint at normal size. Only the ringed joint changes: the shoulder, the elbow or the wrist.
sentence_nl: De arm buigt bij de schouder, de elleboog en de pols.
sentence_en: The arm bends at the shoulder, the elbow and the wrist.

frame: one adult standing whole-figure, front view, plain clothes, arms hanging slightly away from the body, on a flat ground line against a plain wall, the same figure at the same size on the page; a small ring marks one joint at normal size. Only the ringed joint changes: the hip, the knee or the ankle.
sentence_nl: Het been buigt bij de heup, de knie en de enkel.
sentence_en: The leg bends at the hip, the knee and the ankle.

frame: one open adult hand seen palm-forward with the fingers spread, four fingers and a thumb, the same hand at the same size on the page, plain background; a small ring marks one digit at normal size. Only the ringed digit changes: the thumb, the little finger or the index finger.
sentence_nl: De duim is dik, de pink is klein en de wijsvinger wijst.
sentence_en: The thumb is thick, the little finger is small and the index finger points.

frame: one empty seat on wheels standing on a flat pavement line against a plain wall, seen side-on, the same size on the page, nobody sitting in it. Only the seat changes: a wheelchair with two large hand-rims and two small front wheels, or a pram with a deep hooded carrycot and a push bar.
sentence_nl: De rolstoel is voor wie niet kan lopen, de kinderwagen is voor de baby.
sentence_en: The wheelchair is for someone who cannot walk, the pram is for the baby.

frame: one small grooming tool lying flat on a plain shelf line, seen from above, whole object, the same length on the page, no toothpaste, no hair. Only the tool changes: a flat comb with a row of thin teeth, or a toothbrush with a long handle and a small tuft of bristles.
sentence_nl: De kam is voor je haar, de tandenborstel voor je tanden.
sentence_en: The comb is for your hair, the toothbrush for your teeth.

frame: one tree on a flat ground line under plain sky, drawn with the ground cut away below so its roots show, the same tree at the same size on the page, no person; a small ring marks the featured part at normal size. Only the ringed part changes: a branch, the trunk or the roots.
sentence_nl: De tak groeit aan de stam en de wortel zit in de grond.
sentence_en: The branch grows on the trunk and the root is in the ground.

frame: one small garden building standing on a flat grass line under plain sky, seen from the front at a slight angle, the same size and shape on the page, a pitched roof and a door, no person. Only the walls and roof change: solid planks with nothing visible, or glass panes with young plants inside.
sentence_nl: De fietsen staan in de schuur, de tomaten groeien in de kas.
sentence_en: The bikes are kept in the shed, the tomatoes grow in the greenhouse.

frame: one goods vehicle parked side-on on a flat road line against a plain wall, whole vehicle, drawn to the same scale on the page, no logo, no writing, no driver visible. Only the vehicle changes: a big lorry with a separate cab and a long box trailer, or a small van in one piece with a sliding side door.
sentence_nl: De vrachtwagen is groot, de bestelwagen is klein.
sentence_en: The lorry is big, the van is small.

frame: one flying machine hovering in plain sky above a flat ground line, seen side-on, the same size on the page, nobody on the ground, no logo. Only the machine changes: a helicopter with a cabin, one big rotor on top and a tail, or a small drone with four small rotors on short arms.
sentence_nl: De helikopter vervoert mensen, de drone maakt foto's.
sentence_en: The helicopter carries people, the drone takes photos.

frame: one meeting of four roads seen straight from above, the roads as plain strips with edge lines and grass in the corners, the same size on the page, no cars, no signs, no arrows. Only the middle changes: the roads cross in an open square, or they meet around a round island.
sentence_nl: Op het kruispunt kruisen de wegen elkaar, op de rotonde rijd je in een cirkel.
sentence_en: At the crossroads the roads cross, at the roundabout you drive in a circle.

frame: one loose coil of line lying on a plain table line, seen from slightly above, the same size of coil on the page, no hands, no tool. Only the line changes: a thick smooth electric cable with a plug, a twisted rope, or a thin thread wound on a small spool.
sentence_nl: Door de kabel gaat stroom, het touw is sterk en de draad is dun.
sentence_en: Current runs through the cable, the rope is strong and the thread is thin.

frame: one hand tool lying flat on a plain workbench line, seen from above, whole tool, the same length on the page, no hand, no nails, no wood. Only the tool changes: a hammer with a heavy head, a saw with a toothed blade, or pliers with two gripping jaws.
sentence_nl: Je slaat met de hamer, je zaagt met de zaag en je knijpt met de tang.
sentence_en: You hit with the hammer, you saw with the saw and you grip with the pliers.

frame: one jacket front lying flat and closed on a plain table line, seen from the front, the same jacket at the same size on the page, no person, no pattern. Only the fastening changes: a row of round buttons through buttonholes, or one long zip with a pull tab.
sentence_nl: De knoop is van de jas af, maar de rits werkt nog.
sentence_en: The button has come off the coat, but the zip still works.

frame: one adult woman seen from the front from the waist up, plain top, one forearm raised beside the shoulder with the hand open, the same figure at the same size on the page, no pendant, no stones. Only where the thin chain of small round links is worn changes: round the neck, or round the wrist of the raised arm.
sentence_nl: De ketting draag je om je hals, de armband om je pols.
sentence_en: You wear the necklace round your neck, the bracelet round your wrist.

frame: one adult man's head seen from the front, short hair, neutral mouth, the same face at the same size on the page, plain background. Only the facial hair changes: a full beard on the chin and cheeks with a bare upper lip, or a moustache on the upper lip with a bare chin.
sentence_nl: De baard zit op zijn kin, de snor boven zijn lip.
sentence_en: The beard is on his chin, the moustache above his lip.

frame: one thin sharp metal shaft lying flat on a plain table line, seen from above, the same length on the page, no thread, no fabric. Only the blunt end changes: a needle with a small eye to thread through, or a pin with a small round head.
sentence_nl: Door de naald gaat een draad, de speld houdt de stof vast.
sentence_en: A thread goes through the needle, the pin holds the fabric in place.

frame: one knitted winter item lying flat on a plain table line, seen from above, the same knit lines and the same size on the page, no person, no pattern. Only the item changes: a long scarf with fringed ends, a round hat with a folded brim, or a glove with separate fingers.
sentence_nl: De sjaal gaat om je nek, de muts op je hoofd en de handschoen aan je hand.
sentence_en: The scarf goes round your neck, the hat on your head and the glove on your hand.

frame: one keyboard instrument standing against a plain wall on a flat floor line, seen from the front, the same keyboard width on the page, a closed bench in front, no player, no sheet music. Only the instrument changes: an upright piano with a plain wooden case, or an organ with rows of tall pipes above the keys.
sentence_nl: De piano heeft snaren, het orgel heeft pijpen.
sentence_en: The piano has strings, the organ has pipes.

frame: one water bird floating side-on on a flat wavy water line under plain sky, whole bird, the same size on the page, no person, no bread. Only the bird changes: a duck with a short neck and a flat broad bill, or a swan with a long curved neck.
sentence_nl: De eend heeft een korte hals, de zwaan een lange hals.
sentence_en: The duck has a short neck, the swan a long neck.

frame: one large thick-skinned animal standing side-on on a flat dry ground line under plain sky, whole body, the same size on the page, no person, no tree. Only the animal changes: an elephant with a long trunk and big ears, or a rhinoceros with a horn on its nose.
sentence_nl: De olifant heeft een slurf, de neushoorn heeft een hoorn.
sentence_en: The elephant has a trunk, the rhinoceros has a horn.

frame: one big cat standing side-on on a flat ground line under plain sky, whole body, the same size and pose on the page, the coat marks drawn as cobalt line only. Only the coat marks change: long narrow stripes across the body, or small rings with a dot inside.
sentence_nl: De tijger heeft strepen, de jaguar heeft vlekken.
sentence_en: The tiger has stripes, the jaguar has spots.

frame: one thing called de kraan, seen side-on against a plain background, the same size on the page, no person. Only the thing changes: a water tap fixed above a sink, or a tall building crane with a long arm and a hook.
sentence_nl: De kraan in de keuken lekt, de kraan op de bouw is hoog.
sentence_en: The tap in the kitchen drips, the crane on the building site is tall.

frame: one long coiled thing lying on a flat grass line under plain sky, seen from slightly above, the same coil size on the page, no person. Only the thing changes: a snake with a head, eyes and a forked tongue, or a garden hose with a spray nozzle.
sentence_nl: De slang in het gras is een dier, de slang bij de kraan is van plastic.
sentence_en: The snake in the grass is an animal, the hose by the tap is plastic.

frame: one small flying insect resting on a plain wall, seen from above and drawn large, the same size on the page, no person, no food. Only the insect changes: a fly with a stout hairy body and very big round eyes, or a mosquito with a thin body, very long legs and a long straight snout.
sentence_nl: De vlieg zit op het eten, de mug steekt.
sentence_en: The fly sits on the food, the mosquito bites.

frame: one closed kitchen appliance set into a plain cupboard wall at chest height, seen from the front, the same width on the page, no food, no person. Only the appliance changes: an oven with a square door, racks and a bar handle, or a microwave, a low wide box with a side door and blank buttons.
sentence_nl: In de oven bak ik brood, in de magnetron warm ik soep op.
sentence_en: In the oven I bake bread, in the microwave I heat up soup.

frame: one small animal sitting side-on on bare earth in low grass beside a plain pond edge, under plain sky, whole animal, the same size on the page, no person. Only the animal changes: a frog with smooth skin, bulging eyes and long folded back legs, or a tortoise with a high domed shell, short scaly legs and a small head.
sentence_nl: De kikker springt, de schildpad loopt heel langzaam.
sentence_en: The frog jumps, the tortoise walks very slowly.
